adds.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
adds.text: T'Challa dies of an illness, and Ayo helps carry his casket at his funeral.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Ayo's king, whose casket she helps carry.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A Dora Milaje guard who helps carry T'Challa's casket.
adds.evidence: Opening funeral: T'Challa dies before Shuri can recreate the herb; Ayo attends and carries the casket until a Royal Talon Fighter takes it. T'Challa is never on screen alive, so this is a death stage only.

adds.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
adds.text: T'Challa dies of an illness, and M'Baku mourns him at his funeral.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The king M'Baku mourns at his funeral.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The Jabari leader who mourns T'Challa at his funeral.
adds.evidence: M'Baku attends T'Challa's funeral and, unlike the others, does not cross his arms in salute because he is mourning. T'Challa is never on screen alive, so this is a death stage only.

adds.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
adds.text: M'Baku trades insults with Okoye at Ramonda's council. When Talokan floods the city, Okoye tells him to pull Shuri away while she tries to revive Ramonda.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The general who trades insults with M'Baku and has him hold Shuri back.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The Jabari leader who trades insults with Okoye and holds Shuri back for her.
adds.evidence: Emergency council after Namor's visit: M'Baku and Okoye trade insults until Ramonda stops them. Attack on Birnin Zana: Okoye yells at M'Baku and Aneka to get Shuri away as she works on Ramonda.

adds.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
adds.text: Back in Wakanda, Nakia talks with Okoye about T'Challa. When Talokan floods the city, they rescue people together and try to revive Ramonda, until Nakia tells Okoye it is too late.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An old friend who tries with Nakia to save Ramonda.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An old friend who tells Okoye it is too late to save Ramonda.
adds.evidence: Nakia returns to Wakanda and talks with Okoye about T'Challa; when the city floods they rescue civilians and reach the Citadel, where Nakia stops Okoye's attempts to revive Ramonda.

adds.title: Iron Man 2
adds.text: In Monaco, Christine Everhart is interviewing Justin Hammer and tries to make Tony jealous, but he shrugs her off by bringing up their night together. She then presses him about his ties to Hammer.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A billionaire who shrugs off Christine's jabs in Monaco.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A reporter who needles Tony in Monaco while interviewing Hammer.
adds.evidence: Monaco bar: Everhart, there to interview Hammer for Vanity Fair, tries to make Stark jealous, is humiliated when he mentions their tryst, and questions him about Hammer.

adds.title: Iron Man 2
adds.text: In Monaco, Christine Everhart asks Pepper for a quote on her new job running Stark Industries, and Pepper mocks her past story on Tony.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A reporter who asks Pepper for a quote in Monaco.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The new Stark Industries CEO who mocks Christine in Monaco.
adds.evidence: Monaco: Everhart asks Potts for a quote on her promotion to CEO; Potts and Stark mock Hammer and Everhart ('she did quite a... spread on Tony last year').

adds.title: Iron Man 2
adds.text: Tony has Dum-E help him synthesize his father's new element, then sets the robot to cleaning up the mess.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The creator who has Dum-E help make a new element.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Workshop robots that help Tony make his new element.
adds.evidence: Stark tasks Dum-E with helping synthesize the new element and has it clean up afterward.

adds.title: Iron Man 2
adds.text: When Ivan Vanko attacks Tony at Monaco, Happy drives Pepper onto the track to bring him his suit. Happy then starts working for Pepper as the new CEO and pulls her to safety at Tony's birthday party.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The new CEO Happy drives and guards.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Pepper's driver and bodyguard, who gets her onto the Monaco track.
adds.evidence: Monaco: Hogan drives onto the track one-handed while Potts unlocks the suitcase armor's handcuff. Birthday party: Hogan pulls Potts to safety. Next day he collects her for a meeting, now working for her.

adds.title: Iron Man 2
adds.text: Happy spars with Tony in the boxing ring, and when Ivan Vanko attacks Tony at Monaco, Happy rams Vanko with a car to get Tony his suit.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Happy's sparring partner, saved by him in Monaco.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's sparring partner, who rams Vanko to save him in Monaco.
adds.evidence: Hogan and Stark box together (Stark cheats with MMA moves); at the Monaco race Hogan slams Vanko against the fence with the car and delivers the Mark V armor.

adds.title: Iron Man 2
adds.text: J.A.R.V.I.S. helps Tony study his father's notes and create a new element to replace the palladium poisoning him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Creator J.A.R.V.I.S. helps make a new element.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The AI that helps Tony create his new element.
adds.evidence: J.A.R.V.I.S. researches Anton and Ivan Vanko for Stark, advises him in Monaco, and helps create the new element from Howard Stark's notes.

adds.title: Iron Man 2
adds.text: Pepper points Rhodes to Tony, hoping he can rein him in, and the two talk over Tony's drunken behavior at his birthday party.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who sends Rhodes to talk sense into Tony.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend Pepper turns to when Tony spirals.
adds.evidence: Potts gives Rhodes Stark's location hoping he can help wise him up, and at the birthday party she discusses Stark's behavior with Rhodes before he dons the armor.

adds.title: Iron Man 2
adds.text: Fury leaves Coulson at Tony Stark's house with orders to keep Tony there until he finds a cure for his poisoning.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The agent Fury posts to watch Tony.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The director who posts Coulson to watch Tony.
adds.evidence: After the donut shop meeting, Fury leaves Coulson at Stark's mansion with orders not to let him leave until he finds a cure.

adds.title: Iron Man 2
adds.text: Fury reveals Natalie Rushman is his agent, helps slow Tony's palladium poisoning and hands him his father's old materials. Afterward he keeps Tony on only as a consultant.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The man Fury helps with his father's notes, kept on only as a consultant.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The director who helps Tony with his father's notes, then keeps him as a consultant.
adds.evidence: Fury confronts Stark at the donut shop, reveals Romanoff, has her give him lithium dioxide, provides Howard Stark's materials, and at the debriefing offers Stark only a consultant role.

owner_calls.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
owner_calls.question: Add a Wakanda Forever stage for M'Baku and Nakia? Both are aboard the Sea Leopard, and Fandom says 'Nakia and M'Baku ordered the ship to retreat', but no direct exchange between them is described.
options: Add ally stage: Nakia and M'Baku fight together aboard the Sea Leopard and call the retreat once Shuri takes Namor away.
owner_calls.evidence: Nakia page, Ceasefire section; M'Baku page, Ambush on the Talokanil.
